subject: general
question: Walking (5)/(8) of his normal speed from his home, Tarun is 21 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio = (5/8) ⇒ time ratio = (8/5)

Extra time = (8/5 − 1) = 3/5 of usual time

3/5 of usual time = 21 minutes

Usual time = 21 × (5/3)

**∴ Answer = 35 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = (5/8) of normal speed and delay = 21 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time ∝ 1/Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let usual speed = 8 units, reduced speed = 5 units

⇒ Then time ratio = 8 : 5 (inverse of speed)

⇒ Extra time = 8 − 5 = 3 units

⇒ These 3 units correspond to 21 minutes

⇒ 1 unit = 21/3 = 7 minutes

⇒ Usual time = 5 units = 5 × 7 = 35 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 35 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relation

For fixed distance, Speed × Time = constant

Inverse Proportion

If speed decreases, time increases proportionally.

Ratio Trick

Convert speed ratio to time ratio by taking inverse.

Shortcut Formula

Extra time = (difference in time ratio / smaller ratio) × actual time
